page.title: 省略と注釈で文をシャープに

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、法助動詞・完了のhave・be・不定詞toなど復元の手掛かりだけを残す省略と、if possible／if necessary／if anyの条件圧縮、同格・挿入語句で説明や態度を差し込む方法を扱う。
grammarPoints: 助動詞、完了のhave、be、不定詞toを残して既出の動詞句を省略する
if possible、if necessary、if required、if anyで条件節を短くする
名詞句の同格は同一人物・物・内容を別の表現で説明する
however、in fact、I believeなどは文の骨格から外して挿入できる
visualEvidence: 長い反復部分が消え、can・have・be・toだけが残る省略レーン
if it is possibleからif possibleへ圧縮される矢印
名詞と同格説明をコンマやダッシュで接続する図
本文の流れへ注釈カードを差し込む挿入表現の図
commonTraps: 現在完了を受ける短答でdoやbeを残す
同格の片側だけにコンマを置く
howeverで独立節をコンマだけで接続する

questions.prompt: The maintenance crew can inspect the elevator tonight, and the security team can ------- as well.

choices.A: does
choices.B: be
choices.D: has

questions.translationJa: 保守担当者は今夜エレベーターを点検でき、警備チームも点検できます。
questions.explanationJa: 前のcan inspect the elevator tonightを受ける短い応答なので、法助動詞canだけを残します。

questions.prompt: The report has not been printed yet, but the invoices -------.

choices.A: have
choices.B: do
choices.D: can

questions.translationJa: 報告書はまだ印刷されていませんが、請求書は印刷済みです。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了受動態have been printedの重複部分を省き、複数主語に合うhaveを残します。

questions.prompt: The west entrance is being renovated, and the east entrance may ------- next month.

choices.A: do
choices.B: have
choices.D: be

questions.translationJa: 西側入口は改装中で、東側入口も来月改装される可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: may be renovatedのrenovatedを文脈から補えるため、法助動詞の後にbeを残します。

questions.prompt: Although I did not intend to attend the reception, the host persuaded me -------.

choices.A: so
choices.B: to
choices.D: that

questions.translationJa: 私は懇親会に出席するつもりではありませんでしたが、主催者に説得されて出席しました。
questions.explanationJa: persuaded me to attend the receptionの既出動詞句を省き、不定詞標識toだけを残します。

questions.prompt: Please attach a copy of the receipt, if -------, before submitting the expense form.

choices.A: possible
choices.B: possibly
choices.D: can

questions.translationJa: 可能であれば、経費申請書を提出する前に領収書の写しを添付してください。
questions.explanationJa: if possibleはif it is possibleの主語とbe動詞を省いた定型的な条件表現です。

questions.prompt: The revised schedule contains few changes, if -------, to the original departure times.

choices.A: some
choices.B: ever
choices.D: not

questions.translationJa: 改訂日程には、元の出発時刻からの変更があるとしてもほとんどありません。
questions.explanationJa: few changes, if anyはif there are any changesを省き、変更がほぼないことを強めます。

questions.prompt: Ms. Chen, our regional sales -------, will lead Friday's client briefing.

choices.A: manages
choices.B: manager
choices.D: management

questions.translationJa: 当社の地域営業部長であるチェンさんが、金曜日の顧客誼明会を担当します。
questions.explanationJa: our regional sales managerはMs. Chenを言い換えて説明する名詞句の同格です。

questions.prompt: The loading dock, -------, will remain open while the main entrance is closed.

choices.A: because
choices.B: unless
choices.D: however

questions.translationJa: しかし、搬入口は正面入口が閉鎖されている間も開いたままです。
questions.explanationJa: howeverは前後を対比する挿入副詞で、両側をコンマで区切って置けます。

questions.prompt: The conference fee includes lunch and, -------, access to all recorded sessions.

choices.A: because of
choices.B: even though
choices.D: as result

questions.translationJa: 会議参加費には昼食に加えて、すべての録画セッションへのアクセスも含まれます。
questions.explanationJa: in additionは追加情報を差し込む挿入表現で、andの後にコンマで挟んで使えます。

questions.prompt: The equipment must be recalibrated before use; otherwise, it may ------- inaccurate readings.

choices.A: produce
choices.B: produces
choices.D: producing

questions.translationJa: 機器は使用前に再校正しなければなりません。さもないと、不正確な測定値が出る可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 法助動詞mayの後には動詞原形produceが必要です。otherwiseは独立節間の論理関係を示す挿入副詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about two teams completing training.

choices.A: The design team has completed the course, and the engineering team is too.
choices.B: The design team has completed the course, and the engineering team has too.
choices.C: The design team has completed the course, and the engineering team does has too.
choices.D: The design team has completed the course, and the engineering team has completed too it.

questions.translationJa: 設計チームは講座を修了し、技術チームも修了しました。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了has completed the courseを受けるので、単数主語の後にhasだけを残した文が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an optional document.

choices.A: Submit the authorization letter, if requires, with the application.
choices.B: Submit the authorization letter, if it requiring, with the application.
choices.C: Submit the authorization letter, if require it, with the application.
choices.D: Submit the authorization letter, if required, with the application.

questions.translationJa: 必要な場合は、申請書とともに承認書を提出してください。
questions.explanationJa: if requiredはif the letter is requiredの主語とbe動詞を省いた受動の条件表現です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence containing an appositive.

choices.A: Our newest analyst, Daniel Ortiz, prepared the market summary.
choices.B: Our newest analyst Daniel Ortiz, prepared the market summary.
choices.C: Our newest analyst, Daniel Ortiz prepared, the market summary.
choices.D: Our newest analyst is Daniel Ortiz, prepared the market summary.

questions.translationJa: 当社の新任アナリストであるダニエル・オルティスが市場概要を作成しました。
questions.explanationJa: Daniel OrtizはOur newest analystを特定して言い換える非制限的同格で、両側をコンマで囲みます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a natural parenthetical comment.

choices.A: The revised estimate is I believe more realistic, than the original.
choices.B: The revised estimate, is I believe, more realistic than the original.
choices.C: The revised estimate is, I believe, more realistic than the original.
choices.D: The revised estimate is, I believing, more realistic than the original.

questions.translationJa: 改訂見積もりは、私が思うに、当初のものより現実的です。
questions.explanationJa: I believeは話者の判断を差し込む挿入節で、文の骨格から外してコンマで囲めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct short response to an offer.

choices.A: “Would you like to review the draft?” “Yes, I'd like so.”
choices.B: “Would you like to review the draft?” “Yes, I'd like do.”
choices.C: “Would you like to review the draft?” “Yes, I'd like.”
choices.D: “Would you like to review the draft?” “Yes, I'd like to.”

questions.translationJa: 「草案を確認しますか」「はい、確認したいです」
questions.explanationJa: would like to review the draftのreview the draftを省き、toを残すのが自然な短答です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a possible extension.

choices.A: The contract may be extended, and the service agreement may is as well.
choices.B: The contract may be extended, and the service agreement may be as well.
choices.C: The contract may be extended, and the service agreement may do as well.
choices.D: The contract may be extended, and the service agreement be may as well.

questions.translationJa: 契約は延長される可能性があり、サービス契約も同様です。
questions.explanationJa: may be extendedを受けるとき、別の単数主語の後にはmay beを残すことができます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a parenthetical transition.

choices.A: The first proposal was costly; the second however met, the budget.
choices.B: The first proposal was costly; however the second, met the budget.
choices.C: The first proposal was costly; the second, however, met the budget.
choices.D: The first proposal was costly, the second, however, met the budget.

questions.translationJa: 最初の提案は高額でしたが、2番目の提案は予算に収まりました。
questions.explanationJa: howeverを独立節の内部へ挿入する場合は両側をコンマで囲み、節同士はセミコロンで結びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about taking action only when needed.

choices.A: The backup generator will be tested again, if necessary.
choices.B: The backup generator will be tested again, if necessity.
choices.C: The backup generator will be tested again, if it necessary is.
choices.D: The backup generator will be tested again, if necessarily.

questions.translationJa: 必要であれば、予備発電機を再度試験します。
questions.explanationJa: if necessaryはif it is necessaryを省いた定型句で、形容詞necessaryを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence in which the verb phrase is omitted.

choices.A: Maya said she would reserve the room, and she was.
choices.B: Maya said she would reserve the room, and she has it did.
choices.C: Maya said she would reserve the room, and she did reserve it room.
choices.D: Maya said she would reserve the room, and she did.

questions.translationJa: マヤは部屋を予約すると言い、実際に予約しました。
questions.explanationJa: didは過去の動詞句reserved the roomを代用し、約束した行為が実行されたことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with explanatory apposition.

choices.A: The deadline Friday at noon—cannot be changed.
choices.B: The deadline—Friday at noon—cannot be changed.
choices.C: The deadline—Friday at noon cannot—be changed.
choices.D: The deadline is—Friday at noon—cannot be changed.

questions.translationJa: 締切、つまり金曜日の正午は変更できません。
questions.explanationJa: Friday at noonはThe deadlineの内容を説明する同格で、ダッシュで両側を区切る形が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The east office has installed the software, and the west office has installed it too.”

choices.A: Only the east office is permitted to install the software.
choices.B: The west office installed different software before the east office.
choices.C: Neither office has completed the software installation.
choices.D: The east office has installed the software, and the west office has too.

questions.translationJa: 東部オフィスはソフトウェアを導入し、西部オフィスも導入しました。
questions.explanationJa: has tooはhas installed the software tooの重複部分を省き、両方が導入済みだという意味を保ちます。
questions.focus: 現在完了の省略による言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Send the original receipt if it is available.”

choices.A: Send every receipt whether it is available or not.
choices.B: Send the original receipt, if available.
choices.C: Do not send the receipt even when it is available.
choices.D: The original receipt must be made available after sending.

questions.translationJa: 入手できる場合は、領収書の原本を送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: if availableはif the original receipt is availableを省いた形で、元文の条件を変えません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Our chief accountant, Ms. Lewis, will sign the form.”

choices.A: Ms. Lewis will ask the chief accountant to sign the form.
choices.B: The chief accountant and Ms. Lewis will sign separate forms.
choices.C: Ms. Lewis, our chief accountant, will sign the form.
choices.D: Ms. Lewis signed the form before becoming chief accountant.

questions.translationJa: 当社の経理責任者であるルイスさんが書類に署名します。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの名詞句の順序を入れ替えても同格関係は同じで、一人の人物を二通りに説明しています。
questions.focus: 同格名詞句の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I think that the launch date is, in fact, too early.”

choices.A: The launch date is, I think, actually too early.
choices.B: I think the launch date was postponed because it was early.
choices.C: The launch date is early only according to the official calendar.
choices.D: I have no opinion about whether the launch date is early.

questions.translationJa: 発売日は、私が思うに、実際には早すぎます。
questions.explanationJa: I thinkとactuallyは挿入位置を変えても、話者の判断と事実強調という元の意味を保てます。
questions.focus: 挿入コメントの位置変換

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Employees may use the side entrance if doing so is necessary.”

choices.A: Employees must use the side entrance at all times.
choices.B: Employees may use the side entrance if necessary.
choices.C: Employees may never use the side entrance.
choices.D: The side entrance is necessary for every employee.

questions.translationJa: 必要な場合、従業員は側面入口を使用しても構いません。
questions.explanationJa: if necessaryはif doing so is necessaryという重複情報を省いた条件句です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The old system is reliable, and the new system will be reliable too.”

choices.A: The new system will replace the old one because neither is reliable.
choices.B: Only the old system is expected to remain reliable.
choices.C: The reliability of both systems has already declined.
choices.D: The old system is reliable, and the new system will be too.

questions.translationJa: 旧システムは信頼でき、新システムも信頼できるでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: will be tooはwill be reliable tooの形容詞を省き、将来の同じ状態を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “There were very few complaints, if there were any complaints at all.”

choices.A: There were few complaints, if any.
choices.B: There were too many complaints to count.
choices.D: There were complaints only if customers submitted forms.

questions.translationJa: 苦情は、あったとしてもごくわずかでした。
questions.explanationJa: if anyはif there were any complaints at allを圧縮し、数量がほぼゼロである含みを保ちます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The proposed route is, according to our driver, the safest.”

choices.A: Our driver proposed a route that is shorter but less safe.
choices.B: The proposed route is safe only when our driver uses it.
choices.C: Our driver says that the proposed route is the safest.
choices.D: No driver has evaluated the safety of the proposed route.

questions.translationJa: 運転手によれば、提案された経路が最も安全です。
questions.explanationJa: according to our driverという挿入的な情報源を、Our driver says that節へ展開して同じ内容を表しています。
questions.focus: 情報源を示す挿入句の展開

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The director planned to attend the ceremony but was unable to attend it.”

choices.A: The director planned to attend the ceremony but was unable to.
choices.B: The director attended the ceremony without planning to.
choices.C: The director canceled the ceremony before anyone attended.
choices.D: The director was able to attend a different ceremony.

questions.translationJa: 取締役は式典に出席する予定でしたが、出席できませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: was unable toのtoの後に既出のattend the ceremonyを省いても、意味は完全に復元できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The lobby was crowded; nevertheless, service remained quick.”

choices.A: Service was slow because the lobby was empty.
choices.B: The lobby was closed until service became quicker.
choices.C: Crowding and service speed were unrelated because service stopped.
choices.D: The lobby was crowded; service, however, remained quick.

questions.translationJa: ロビーは混雑していましたが、それでもサービスは迅速なままでした。
questions.explanationJa: neverthelessと挿入副詞howeverはどちらも逆接を表し、二つの独立節の対照を保ちます。
questions.focus: 逆接の挿入副詞による言い換え

questions.prompt: The customer may ask for a printed receipt. If -------, provide one at the service counter.

choices.A: one
choices.B: does
choices.D: it

questions.translationJa: 顧客が印刷した領収書を求める場合があります。その場合はサービスカウンターで1部渡してください。
questions.explanationJa: if soは直前の可能性the customer asks for a printed receipt全体を条件として受けます。

questions.prompt: The technicians have tested the backup line, and the network administrator ------- too.

choices.A: does
choices.B: has
choices.D: can

questions.translationJa: 技術者たちは予備回線を試験し、ネットワーク管理者も試験済みです。
questions.explanationJa: 単数主語the network administratorの現在完了has tested the backup lineを省き、hasを残します。
questions.focus: 単数主語の完了形省略

questions.prompt: The client requested a later appointment. We will adjust the schedule, if -------.

choices.A: possibly
choices.B: it can
choices.D: possible

questions.translationJa: 顧客はより遅い時間の予約を求めました。可能であれば日程を調整します。
questions.explanationJa: if possibleはif it is possible to adjust the scheduleを簡潔にした定型表現です。

questions.prompt: Our warehouse supervisor, -------, will conduct tomorrow's safety inspection.

choices.A: Mr. Alvarez
choices.B: supervise
choices.D: and safety

questions.translationJa: 当社の倉庫責任者であるアルバレスさんが、明日の安全点検を実施します。
questions.explanationJa: 人名Mr. AlvarezはOur warehouse supervisorを言い換える同格名詞句です。

questions.prompt: The standard package includes installation. On-site training, -------, costs an additional fee.

choices.A: because
choices.B: therefore it
choices.D: unless

questions.translationJa: 標準パッケージには設置が含まれます。しかし、現地研修には追加料金がかかります。
questions.explanationJa: 前文との対照を示し、後続節の内部に挿入できる副詞howeverが最適です。

questions.prompt: Several branches may extend their hours during the sale, and ours may ------- as well.

choices.A: does it
choices.B: do so
choices.D: has

questions.translationJa: セール期間中に営業時間を延長する支店がいくつかあり、当支店もそうする可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 法助動詞mayの後にdo soを置き、extend its hoursという動作全体を受けます。

questions.prompt: The draft contains no factual errors, as far as I can -------.

choices.A: tell
choices.B: told
choices.D: to tell

questions.translationJa: 私が判断できる限り、その草案には事実上の誤りはありません。
questions.explanationJa: as far as I can tellは判断の範囲を控えめに差し込む定型的な挿入節です。
questions.focus: 挿入節as far as I can tell

questions.prompt: The company planned to reopen the café in June but was not able -------.

choices.A: so
choices.B: do
choices.D: to

questions.translationJa: 会社は6月にカフェを再開する予定でしたが、再開できませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: be able to reopen the caféの既出動詞句を省き、不定詞標識toを残します。
questions.focus: able toの後の動詞句省略

questions.prompt: Only minor revisions, if -------, will be needed before the brochure is printed.

choices.A: some
choices.B: any
choices.D: they

questions.translationJa: パンフレットを印刷する前に必要な修正は、あるとしても軽微なものだけです。
questions.explanationJa: if anyはif any revisions are neededを省いた形で、修正量がほぼないことを示します。

questions.prompt: The north wing is currently closed, and the south wing will ------- after 6 p.m.

choices.A: do
choices.B: has
choices.D: so

questions.translationJa: 北棟は現在閉鎖中で、南棟も午後6時以降は閉鎖されます。
questions.explanationJa: will be closedのclosedを省き、将来の受動・状態を示すwill beを完成させるためbeを選びます。
